inference: The four DLC Bolt choices have a boolean flag effect and no numeric cycle operand. The current site has no matching cycle-field override for these choices, so the source scan gives no choice-level RPM or TTK number change within the eight-weapon scope. The conclusion is conditional on serialized input and the current site model.
unresolved: Serialized attachment, import and registry relationships do not prove runtime activation or modifier composition.
The seven DLC Bolt boolean hashes have no exact named GRX_Weapons child association in this release; their values and hash matches are raw verified, but individual field names remain unresolved.

The Class_582cbe36 body contains Field_9e0fcbc7 and Field_681db7bb values without named GRX_Weapons child/hash pairs. WME_Firerate900_M10 also stores 1.0 in other named cycle fields; runtime interpretation is not established.

The P90 Heavy Recoil Spring package reaches WME_Firerate900_M10 through P90_WB, but no corresponding attachment XML route was found in this graph. The asset name alone does not establish an attachment selection.

The target effect graph builder summary records the static label `1.4.2.5 (user supplied label)` although this run passed the 1.4.3.0 xml-overlay root. The positive control assets, decoder captures and crosswalk roots match the pinned 1.4.3.0 hashes; the builder summary label is not a reliable build identity.

The site `secondary_optic` choice is a grouped category. It maps to multiple exported sight routes per weapon; each matched route was scanned, but the site category is not a one-to-one source attachment identifier.
siteImpact: Among the 282 current choices on these eight weapons, the only cycle-class modifier found is the DLC Bolt boolean effect on M2010 ESR, SV-98, PSR and L115. It has no numeric operand for firing rate, bolt-action time/delay, speed or completion fractions. The current site has no matching cycle-term frostyModifiers override for the selected choices. This source trace gives no attachment-driven numeric RPM or TTK adjustment for these eight weapons; runtime activation and composition remain unresolved.

leads.title: Attachment effects on the bolt and pump cycle
leads.summary: All 282 site choices of the six Sniper Rifles and two pump shotguns were resolved on release 1.4.3.0: only the DLC Bolt (ads_bolt) boolean rechamber modifier appears (M2010 ESR, SV-98, PSR, L115) and no choice carries a numeric modifier on the bolt or pump cycle fields, so no displayed sniper or pump RPM changes; the catalog-wide scan adds only WME_Firerate900_M10 (the known orphan USG-90 Heavy Recoil Spring, L93) and the VSSM full-auto package, both outside these weapons.
leads.reopenWhen: Reopen if a release-pinned selector trace adds a numeric target on a scoped weapon cycle field, or a runtime capture changes the activation or composition of the DLC Bolt boolean.
leads.statusNote: No numeric cycle modifier on the 8 weapons (29 Sep)
